title: Spiti Valley Winter Expedition [Verified 2026]
content:
Spiti Valley is one of the most breathtaking cold deserts on the planet. From Key Monastery to Chandratal, every corner tells a majestic tale.

Prepare your warm thermals, acclimatize in Kaza, and respect the fragile high-altitude environment.
excerpt: Explore the frozen wonders of Spiti Valley in winter with ancient monasteries, snow leopard sightings, and crystal clear night skies.
